# Rivverr

> Rivverr is a small design and development studio building custom, design-led websites exclusively for United States businesses. Three fixed-price packages, delivered in 7 to 21 days, no templates or themes.

Rivverr is not a generic web agency or freelance marketplace. It sells three fixed packages — Ripple ($600, 7 days, up to 4 pages), Current ($900, 14 days, up to 8 pages, CMS-backed), and Delta ($1,200, 21 days, unlimited pages, full backend) — each with a fixed price, fixed delivery date, and full client ownership of the finished site (code, design files, domain, hosting).

This site is available only to visitors in the United States; visitors from other countries are redirected to a blocked page, since Rivverr markets and sells only to US-based businesses.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rivverr.com/): Studio overview, pricing case, capabilities, target audience, process, package pricing, FAQ, and contact CTA.
- [Work](https://rivverr.com/work): Portfolio of shipped client projects, each linking to the live site.
- [Contact](https://rivverr.com/contact): Project brief form with package selection; submissions go to info@rivverr.com.

## Key facts

- Pricing: Ripple $600, Current $900, Delta $1,200 (USD, one-time).
- Delivery: 7, 14, and 21 days respectively, from discovery approval.
- Payment: 50% to start, 50% at launch.
- Contact: info@rivverr.com
- Service area: United States businesses only.
